## Summary of Fixes

### 1. Auto-sync for Notes & Sweet Nothings and Shared Tasks & Lists
- Fixed auto-save logic in the update page to prevent circular updates using refs
- Auto-saves after a 500ms debounce
- Dispatches `lovemail-data-updated` to sync across pages
- Main page listens for the event and updates in real time

### 2. Calendar event synchronization
- Calendar events added on the update page sync to the main page
- Events update independently of notes/tasks
- Storage utility dispatches sync events when events are added or removed
- Both pages listen for updates and refresh calendar events

### 3. Current day highlighting
- Enhanced today styling:
  - Ring (`ring-4 ring-[#e8b4a0]`)
  - Larger shadow (`shadow-xl`)
  - Bold text
  - White dot indicator on today's cell
  - Works with or without events (today retains highlighting when an event exists)
- Calendar on both pages highlights today

### 4. Real-time updates
- Main page listens for `lovemail-data-updated`
- Update page listens for external changes
- Prevents circular updates when saving
- Calendar events always update, even while saving notes/tasks

All changes sync across pages. Updates to notes, tasks, or calendar events in the Update page appear on the main page automatically, and today is clearly highlighted on both calendars.
